titre: Centres à ciel ouvert : la fréquentation monte
sous_titre: Variation de la fréquentation sur un an, en %, mois publiés de 2026

Avril 2026.texte: Open-air centers came out on top, extending a trend in place since December 2025, with visits rising 3.5% YoY.

Juin 2026.texte: open-air shopping center visits up 5.1%, and outlet mall visits up 1.0% compared to June 2025

Juillet 2026.texte: continued their outperformance, with YoY traffic up 5.1%

Août 2026.texte: Open-air shopping centers sustained their lead in August 2026, with visits up 6.6% year over year
